messages:
Aisha (sec-eng): FYI — new triage batch affecting inference stack: CVE-2025-0142 (vLLM tokenizer RCE), CVE-2025-0143 (Triton kernel OOB), CVE-2025-0144 (protobuf deserialization). Upstream advisory for sentencepiece flagged as info-only for now. Need decision on patch windows, RBAC for deployers, and whether to force KMS key rewrap/rotation. Links: https://security.example/cves/2025-0142 https://security.example/cves/2025-0143 https://security.example/cves/2025-0144

Marco (eng-runtime): Can you paste short severity & exploitability notes? Any PoC seen in the wild?

Aisha (sec-eng): Short: vLLM = CRITICAL CVSS 9.1 (PoC unconfirmed but exploit path is remote via crafted token stream), Triton = HIGH CVSS 8.6 (kernel OOB; requires GPU access but we run shared pools so elevated risk), protobuf = HIGH CVSS 8.0 (remote deserialization through admin/control endpoints). sentencepiece = LOW/INFO. No confirmed public PoCs yet; vendor PRs available.

Priya (infra): For KMS: do we need to rotate CMKs or just rewrap model keys? Some Private/Dedicated customers will object to forced rotation.

Aisha (sec-eng): Proposal: rotate the service-level signing key used for artifact manifests + rewrap customer model keys only for Hosted by default. For Dedicated/Private, schedule rewrap windows and notify customers. Also add a patch_release_id and patched_packages fields to audit events so we can trace which deployment touched which keys.

sec-bot: automated-cve-summary: CVE-2025-0142(vLLM) link=https://cve.example/142 cvss=9.1 vector=AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H; CVE-2025-0143(Triton) link=https://cve.example/143 cvss=8.6; CVE-2025-0144(protobuf) link=https://cve.example/144 cvss=8.0

Jared (oncall): Operational suggestion: canary protobuf + Triton to a small Dedicated pool first, watch control-plane error rates and GPU OOMs. vLLM patch likely needs model-family rebuilds/quantized weight regen — schedule 7d window for testing. Prepare rollback images.

Marco (eng-runtime): Proposed deploy order based on blast radius: 1) protobuf (control-plane/agent), 2) Triton (runtime kernel/lib), 3) vLLM (model infra + tokenizer). FlashAttention kernel bits might need recompiles; add FlashAttention/ROCm/CUDA build matrix. Need CI jobs for kernel module + small perf sanity tests.

Priya (infra): RBAC change: create a scoped role "patch-deployer" limited to pushing images to "patch-*" namespaces and triggering patch jobs, with audit logging turned on. We'll need owner approval from Security and Infra. Also need a runbook step to avoid auto-rotating customer CMKs without explicit opt-in for Private customers.

Aisha (sec-eng): I'll open a PR with the RBAC delta and audit schema (fields: patch_release_id, packages[], prev_versions[]). Timeline proposal: protobuf + Triton hotpatch within 48h (canary then 100%), vLLM scheduled 7 days with model compatibility testing. sentencepiece monitored.

Marco (eng-runtime): Canary config snippet for rollout:

```
canary:
  percent: 5
  rollback_on: error_rate > 2%
  metrics: [p50_latency, gpu_util, control_plane_errors]
  notify: [#eng-oncall, #eng-runtime]
```

Priya (infra): Will add KMS rotation steps to infra-runbook and ensure rotation event emits: {"event_type":"kms.rotate","patch_release_id":"<id>","affected_keys":[]} to audit-log pipeline.

Aisha (sec-eng): Action items: Aisha - create triage ticket + advisory draft; Marco - build matrix + canary pipelines; Priya - prepare RBAC role + KMS rotation runbook; Jared - monitor canary and own rollback; sec-oncall - set alert thresholds. Tagging @security @infra @runtime. :eyes: :shipit:

Marco (eng-runtime): quick note — include FlashAttention ABI check in build matrix, and ensure quantization kernels recompile if we apply upstream patches.

Jared (oncall): I'll reserve a 2-hour warroom window for initial canary monitoring. Will escalate to incident if error_rate > 2% or p99 latency spikes > 500ms.

Aisha (sec-eng): Thanks all — I'll post the ticket and PR links here when created. Keeping this thread as the coordination log for audit purposes.
